```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

# Pull the parameter from YAML into the R environment
run_full_refit <- params$run_full_refit

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial"))
update_geom_defaults("text", list(family = "Arial"))

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

conflicted::conflict_prefer("setequal", "base", quiet = TRUE)
conflicted::conflict_prefer("intersect", "base", quiet = TRUE)

figure_output_dir <- here::here("fig_s5_files")
dir.create(figure_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Processed figure input

```{r load_benchmark_results}
auc_results_path <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "04_integrative_modeling",
  "figure_s4_auc_by_split.csv"
)

model_metadata_path <- here::here(
  "data",
  "processed",
  "04_integrative_modeling",
  "figure_s4_model_metadata.csv"
)

benchmark_results_available <- all(file.exists(
  auc_results_path,
  model_metadata_path
))

if (benchmark_results_available) {
  auc_results <- read.csv(
    auc_results_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble()

  model_metadata <- read.csv(
    model_metadata_path,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    na.strings = c("", "NA")
  ) |>
    tibble::as_tibble() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      panel_b_label = gsub("\\\\n", "\n", panel_b_label),
      panel_b_order = as.integer(panel_b_order)
    )

  required_auc_columns <- c("model", "sim", "auc")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_auc_columns, names(auc_results))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The Figure S5 AUC table is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  required_metadata_columns <- c(
    "model", "median_k", "panel_a_universe", "panel_a_type",
    "panel_b_label", "panel_b_order"
  )
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_metadata_columns, names(model_metadata))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The Figure S5 model metadata table is missing: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # The original per-split coefficient-count object was not saved on the
  # server. Its displayed median K values are preserved explicitly in this
  # metadata table; see scripts/archive/figure_s4/README.md.
  format_k <- function(x) {
    ifelse(
      abs(x - round(x)) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps),
      as.character(round(x)),
      format(round(x, 1), nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)
    )
  }

  model_metadata <- model_metadata |>
    dplyr::mutate(label_k = paste0("Med K=", format_k(median_k)))

  results_with_k <- auc_results |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      model = as.character(model),
      sim = as.integer(sim),
      auc = as.numeric(auc)
    ) |>
    dplyr::left_join(model_metadata, by = "model")

  missing_models <- setdiff(
    unique(model_metadata$model),
    unique(results_with_k$model)
  )
  if (length(missing_models) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The Figure S5 AUC table is missing models: ",
      paste(missing_models, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  unmatched_models <- setdiff(
    unique(results_with_k$model),
    unique(model_metadata$model)
  )
  if (length(unmatched_models) > 0) {
    stop(
      "The Figure S5 metadata table is missing models: ",
      paste(unmatched_models, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  best_fair_k <- model_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(panel_b_label == "Fair-K") |>
    dplyr::pull(model)

  if (length(best_fair_k) != 1) {
    stop("Exactly one model must be labeled Fair-K in panel B metadata.")
  }

  benchmark_set <- model_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(panel_b_order)) |>
    dplyr::arrange(panel_b_order) |>
    dplyr::pull(model)

  competitor_map <- model_metadata |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(panel_a_universe)) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      model,
      universe = panel_a_universe,
      type = panel_a_type
    )
} else {
  message(
    "Figure S5 inputs are unavailable: ",
    auc_results_path,
    " and ",
    model_metadata_path
  )
}
```

## Optional full model refit

Routine renders use the compact per-split results above. To rebuild the
published panels and rerun the nested cross-validation analysis from the
underlying assay objects, render with:

```text
quarto render fig_s5.qmd -P run_full_refit:true
```

```{r full_refit_libraries, eval=run_full_refit}
library(glmmLasso)
library(caret)
library(future)
library(furrr)
library(progressr)
library(webchem)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(janitor)

options(expressions = 10000)
```

```{r infrastructure, eval=run_full_refit}
available_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = TRUE)
workers <- max(1, min(24, available_cores - 2))
future::plan(future::multisession, workers = workers)
progressr::handlers(global = TRUE)
progressr::handlers("txtprogressbar")
```

### Published panel construction

```{r published_panels, eval=run_full_refit}
published_panel_dir <- here::here(
  "data", "raw", "04_integrative_modeling", "published_panels"
)
metabolon_superset_path <- here::here(
  "data", "intermediate", "04_integrative_modeling",
  "metabolon_superset.csv"
)

source_paths <- c(
  fitzgerald = file.path(
    published_panel_dir,
    "fitzgerald_supplementary_table_1.csv"
  ),
  kehoe = file.path(published_panel_dir, "kehoe_table_5.csv"),
  molins = file.path(
    published_panel_dir,
    "molins_supplementary_table_1.csv"
  ),
  metabolon_superset = metabolon_superset_path
)

missing_source_files <- source_paths[!file.exists(source_paths)]
if (length(missing_source_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Missing published-panel source files: ",
    paste(missing_source_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

metabolon_superset <- readr::read_csv(
  metabolon_superset_path,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    CHEMICAL_ID = readr::col_character(),
    PUBCHEM = readr::col_character(),
    CAS = readr::col_character(),
    cid = readr::col_character()
  )
)

lookup_pubchem_cids <- function(query, from = "name", attempts = 3L) {
  if (is.na(query) || !nzchar(trimws(query)) || query == "-") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  q_clean <- trimws(query)

  # Hardcoded CID dictionary for structures mapped across panels
  cid_dict <- c(
    "Theobromine" = "5429",
    "Tryptophan" = "6305",
    "Piperine" = "638024",
    "Phenylalanine" = "6140",
    "10-Nitrooleate" = "24836820",
    "9,10-DiHOME" = "9966640",
    "Cholesteryl acetate" = "2723897",
    "C16 Sulfatide" = "9897094",
    "Ile Leu Trp" = "145456198",
    "DL-Stearoylcarnitine" = "6426855",
    "Resolvin E2" = "16061125",
    "LysoPC(14:0)" = "460604",
    "Trans-2, 3, 4-Trimethoxycinnamate" = "735841",
    "Bilirubin" = "5280352",
    "Gamma-Linolenic acid" = "5280933",
    "PGA3" = "5283112",
    "-(-)-Morphine" = "5288826",
    "PG(22:1(11Z)/0:0)" = "52927449",
    "PI(22:0/22:0)" = "75961244",
    "TG(16:0/16:0/16:0)" = "11147",
    "Phe Trp" = "134906",
    "DG(18:2(9Z,12Z)/18:3(9Z,12Z,15Z)/0:0)[iso2]" = "9543737",
    "DG(18:1(11E)/16:0/0:0)" = "5283470",
    "Ala Cys Asp Arg" = "44564339",
    "Asp His Pro Tyr" = "135529004",
    "PI(O-16:0/16:1(9Z))" = "52928422",
    "Ile Ile Lys Val" = "71402611",
    "PG(12:0/17:0)" = "52926315"
  )

  if (q_clean %in% names(cid_dict)) {
    return(unname(cid_dict[q_clean]))
  }

  # Fallback to local lookup in metabolon_superset
  if (exists("metabolon_superset") && "BIOCHEMICAL_NAME" %in% names(metabolon_superset)) {
    match_idx <- match(tolower(q_clean), tolower(metabolon_superset$BIOCHEMICAL_NAME))
    if (!is.na(match_idx)) {
      match_val <- metabolon_superset$PUBCHEM[match_idx]
      if (!is.na(match_val)) {
        return(as.character(match_val))
      }
    }
  }

  NA_character_
}

fitzgerald_source <- readr::read_csv(
  source_paths[["fitzgerald"]],
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Molins Supplementary Table 1 contains 95 molecular features. The published
# LASSO and classification-tree flags define the 24-feature candidate panel.
molins_source <- readr::read_csv(
  source_paths[["molins"]],
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(
    predicted_formula = compound_predicted_formula,
    predicted_structure =
      predicted_chemical_structure_based_on_accurate_mass_a,
    in_lasso = m_fs_in_lasso_model,
    in_lda = m_fs_in_lda_model,
    in_ct = m_fs_in_ct_model
  )

molins_selected <- molins_source |>
  dplyr::filter(
    predicted_formula != "-",
    in_lasso == "x" | in_ct == "x"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pubchem_cid_from_name = purrr::map(
      predicted_structure,
      lookup_pubchem_cids
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(
    pubchem_cid_from_name,
    values_to = "pubchem_cid_from_name"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(mf_number) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1L) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# These assignments are the retained results of the original formula and
# synonym fallback for structures that PubChem does not resolve by name.
molins_formula_matches <- tibble::tribble(
  ~mf_number, ~pubchem_cid_from_formula,
  5,          "5288826",
  11,         "52927449",
  20,         "5283470",
  27,         "44564339",
  28,         "75961244",
  35,         "11147",
  37,         "135529004",
  44,         "52928422",
  50,         "134906",
  52,         "71402611",
  76,         "9543737",
  87,         "52926315"
)

molins_mapping <- molins_selected |>
  dplyr::left_join(molins_formula_matches, by = "mf_number") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pubchem_cid = dplyr::coalesce(
      pubchem_cid_from_formula,
      pubchem_cid_from_name
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pubchem_cid))

# Kehoe Table 5 reports 42 structurally identified metabolites. Level-1
# identities are resolved by name; the four level-2 lipid/peptide identities
# retain the explicit PubChem assignments used in the original analysis.
kehoe_source <- readr::read_csv(
  source_paths[["kehoe"]],
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    rt_min = `RT (m)`,
    mz = `m/z`,
    structural_id = `Structural ID`,
    level = Level,
    msms = `MS/MS`,
    description = Description
  )

kehoe_level_1 <- kehoe_source |>
  dplyr::filter(level == 1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pubchem_cid = purrr::map(structural_id, lookup_pubchem_cids)
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(pubchem_cid)

kehoe_level_2 <- kehoe_source |>
  dplyr::filter(level == 2) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pubchem_cid = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("^Phe.Phe$", structural_id, useBytes = TRUE) ~ list("6993090"),
      structural_id ==
        "14(15)-Epoxy-5Z,8Z,11Z-eicosatrienoic acid [M-H2O]+" ~
        list("5283205"),
      structural_id == "PC(O-18:0/0:0)" ~ list(c("2733532", "3985")),
      structural_id == "PC(P-16:0/0:0)" ~ list("10917802"),
      TRUE ~ list(NA_character_)
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(pubchem_cid)

kehoe_mapping <- dplyr::bind_rows(kehoe_level_1, kehoe_level_2)
kehoe_mapping <- kehoe_mapping |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pubchem_cid))

# Fitzgerald Supplementary Table 1 reports 106 small-molecule metabolites.
# Only level-1 or level-2 identifications can be mapped by chemical identity.
fitzgerald_mapping <- fitzgerald_source |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`ID level`), !is.na(`Best ID`)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pubchem_cid = purrr::map(`Best ID`, lookup_pubchem_cids)
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_longer(pubchem_cid) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pubchem_cid))

published_metabolite_features <- dplyr::bind_rows(
```

### Preserved pilot calculation

```{r preliminary, eval=FALSE}
# How many outer resamples do we need to estimate the final mean AUC precisely?

## ------------------------------
## Inputs you may tweak
## ------------------------------
Npilot           <- 40          # pilot splits to estimate SD of AUC
target_halfwidth <- 0.01        # desired 95% CI half-width for mean AUC
buffer_factor    <- 1.25        # 25% buffer applied to required R
lambda_min       <- 5           # λ range (log-spaced)
lambda_max       <- 30
lambda_n         <- 12
corr_cutoff      <- 0.75        # correlation pruning threshold
max_resample     <- 50          # max tries to get stratified test set

## ------------------------------
## Load and prepare data (unchanged defaults downstream)
## ------------------------------
load(here::here(
  "data", "raw", "01_proteomics_metabolomics", "OlinkPreprocessed.RData"
))
sampleData <- data$sampleData

outcomes <- sampleData %>%
  select(sample, Subject_ID, Condition, time) %>%
  mutate(
    infected   = if_else(Condition == "Patient" & time == "T1", 1, 0),
    sample     = as.factor(sample),
    Subject_ID = as.factor(Subject_ID),
    Condition  = as.factor(Condition),
    time       = as.factor(time)
  )

load(here::here(
  "data", "processed", "01_proteomics_metabolomics", "Data.RData"
))
metabolic_data   <- data$metabolon$pat_data %>% rownames_to_column("sample")
immune_data      <- data$data %>% select(1:sample) %>% relocate(sample)
physiologic_data <- data$olinkNew %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% filter(if_any(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample")

## ------------------------------
## Helpers
## ------------------------------
clean_design <- function(df, outcome_df, corr_cut = 0.75) {
  combined <- inner_join(outcome_df, df, by = "sample")
  colnames(combined) <- make.names(colnames(combined))

  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
    select(where(~ !is.numeric(.) || isTRUE(stats::var(., na.rm = TRUE) > 0))) %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

  nzv <- caret::nearZeroVar(combined, saveMetrics = TRUE) %>% filter(nzv) %>% rownames()
  combined <- combined %>% select(-any_of(nzv))

  highly_cor <- combined %>%
    select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
    cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>%
    caret::findCorrelation(cutoff = corr_cut, names = TRUE)

  combined %>% select(-all_of(highly_cor))
}

make_formula <- function(clean_df) {
  # Columns that should NEVER be used as predictors
  nonpred <- intersect(
    c("sample", "Subject_ID", "Condition", "time", "infected"),
    names(clean_df)
  )

  rhs_vars <- setdiff(names(clean_df), nonpred)

  if (length(rhs_vars) == 0L) {
    stop("make_formula(): no predictors left after excluding non-predictor columns.")
  }

  stats::as.formula(
    paste("infected ~", paste(rhs_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )
}

lambda_grid_log <- function(lmin, lmax, n) {
  lmin <- max(lmin, 1e-4)
  lmax <- max(lmax, lmin * 1.01)
  exp(seq(log(lmin), log(lmax), length.out = n))
}

safe_fit_once <- function(formula_fix, rnd, family, data, lambda) {
  out <- try(
    glmmLasso(
      fix = formula_fix, rnd = rnd, family = family, data = data,
      lambda = lambda    # keep package defaults (centering/standardization on)
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) NULL else out
}

auc_from_fit <- function(fit, newdata, y_vec) {
  p <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "response") %>% as.numeric()
  pROC::auc(pROC::roc(response = y_vec, predictor = p, levels = c(0,1), direction = "<")) %>% as.numeric()
}

subject_split_stratified <- function(df, prop = 0.8, max_tries = 50) {
  subs <- df$Subject_ID %>% as.character() %>% unique()
  n_tr <- floor(length(subs) * prop)
  for (i in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    tr_sub <- sample(subs, size = n_tr, replace = FALSE)
    train  <- df %>% filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_sub)
    test   <- df %>% filter(!Subject_ID %in% tr_sub)
    if (length(unique(test$infected)) == 2) return(list(train = train, test = test))
  }
  warning("Could not guarantee class balance in test after max_tries; proceeding with last draw.")
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

# Scan λ, keep only successful fits, pick LOWER λ on AUC ties
best_auc_with_tiebreak <- function(train_df, test_df, formula_fix, lambda_seq) {
  rows <- vector("list", length(lambda_seq))
  k <- 0
  for (lam in lambda_seq) {
    fit <- safe_fit_once(formula_fix, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), train_df, lam)
    if (!is.null(fit)) {
      k <- k + 1
      auc_val <- auc_from_fit(fit, test_df, test_df$infected)
      rows[[k]] <- tibble(lambda_success = lam, auc = auc_val)
    }
  }
  if (k == 0) return(tibble(lambda_success = NA_real_, auc = NA_real_))
  df <- bind_rows(rows[seq_len(k)])
  max_auc <- max(df$auc, na.rm = TRUE)
  tol <- 1e-12
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(auc), (max_auc - auc) <= tol) %>%
    slice_min(lambda_success, n = 1)
}

## ------------------------------
## Build ONLY the "both" design and formula
## ------------------------------
combined_both <- clean_design(
  purrr::reduce(list(physiologic_data, immune_data, metabolic_data), inner_join, by = "sample"),
  outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff
)
form_both <- make_formula(combined_both)

out_dir <- here("results")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
pilot_results_path <- file.path(out_dir, "pilot_both_per_split_best_auc.csv")
pilot_summary_path <- file.path(out_dir, "pilot_both_required_sims.csv")

if (file.exists(pilot_results_path) && file.exists(pilot_summary_path)) {
  pilot_results <- readr::read_csv(
    pilot_results_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  pilot_summary <- readr::read_csv(
    pilot_summary_path,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  message("Loaded cached pilot results from results/.")
} else {
  ## ------------------------------
  ## Pilot loop (ONLY the "both" model)
  ## ------------------------------
  lam_seq <- lambda_grid_log(lambda_min, lambda_max, lambda_n)

  pilot_rows <- vector("list", Npilot)
  for (sim in seq_len(Npilot)) {
    sp <- subject_split_stratified(combined_both, prop = 0.8, max_tries = max_resample)
    best <- best_auc_with_tiebreak(sp$train, sp$test, form_both, lam_seq) %>%
      mutate(model = "both", sim = sim)
    pilot_rows[[sim]] <- best
  }

  pilot_results <- bind_rows(pilot_rows) %>%
    relocate(model, sim, lambda_success, auc)

  ## ------------------------------
  ## Pilot summary and required R (+25% buffer)
  ## ------------------------------
  pilot_summary <- pilot_results %>%
    summarise(
      R_pilot   = sum(!is.na(auc)),
      mean_auc  = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_auc    = sd(auc,  na.rm = TRUE),
      req_R_95  = ceiling((1.96 * sd_auc / target_halfwidth)^2),
      req_R_95_with_buffer = ceiling(req_R_95 * buffer_factor)
    )

  print(pilot_summary)

  readr::write_csv(pilot_results, pilot_results_path)
  readr::write_csv(pilot_summary, pilot_summary_path)
}

```

```{r main_simulation, eval=run_full_refit}

#### ---------------------------------------------------------------

## ------------------------------
## Helpers
## ------------------------------
clean_design <- function(df, outcome_df, corr_cut = 0.75, verbose = FALSE) {
  # Keep outcome/id factors intact. Apply NZV and correlation pruning only to numeric predictors.
  nonpred <- c("sample","Subject_ID","Condition","time","infected")

  combined <- dplyr::inner_join(outcome_df, df, by = "sample")
  colnames(combined) <- make.names(colnames(combined))

  # Impute numeric with column median; drop all-NA columns.
  combined <- combined %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ ifelse(is.na(.), stats::median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)
    )) %>%
    dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

  # Work on numeric predictors only (exclude nonpred).
  num_pred <- combined %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(nonpred)) %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

  # Drop zero-variance numeric columns explicitly (prevents NA in cor).
  if (ncol(num_pred) > 0) {
    sds <- vapply(num_pred, stats::sd, numeric(1), na.rm = TRUE)
    num_pred <- num_pred[, sds > 0, drop = FALSE]
  }

  # NZV on remaining numeric predictors.
  nzv_names <- character(0)
  if (ncol(num_pred) > 0) {
    nzv_tbl   <- caret::nearZeroVar(num_pred, saveMetrics = TRUE)
    nzv_names <- rownames(nzv_tbl)[nzv_tbl$nzv | nzv_tbl$zeroVar]
  }

  # Correlation pruning on numeric predictors. Use complete obs; no NA now.
  highly_cor <- character(0)
  if (ncol(num_pred) > 1) {
    R <- stats::cor(num_pred, use = "complete.obs")
    # guard: if any NA sneak in, drop their columns before findCorrelation
    if (any(is.na(R))) {
      keep <- which(colSums(is.na(R)) == 0)
      if (length(keep) > 1) R <- R[keep, keep, drop = FALSE] else R <- NULL
    }
    if (!is.null(R) && ncol(R) > 1) {
      highly_cor <- caret::findCorrelation(R, cutoff = corr_cut, names = TRUE)
    }
  }

  combined %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c(nzv_names, highly_cor)))
}

make_formula <- function(clean_df) {
  nonpred <- c("sample","Subject_ID","Condition","time","infected")
  rhs_vars <- setdiff(names(clean_df), nonpred)
  if (length(rhs_vars) == 0L) {
    stop("No predictors left after pruning in make_formula().")
  }
  stats::as.formula(paste("infected ~", paste(rhs_vars, collapse = " + ")))
}


lambda_grid_log <- function(lmin, lmax, n) {
  lmin <- max(lmin, 1e-4); lmax <- max(lmax, lmin * 1.01)
  exp(seq(log(lmin), log(lmax), length.out = n))
}

safe_fit_once <- function(formula_fix, rnd, family, data, lambda) {
  # 1. Identify numeric predictors in the data
  #    (Exclude the random effect ID and the outcome)
  rhs_vars <- all.vars(formula_fix)[-1] 
  
  # 2. Check for zero-variance columns in this specific subset
  #    (This happens often in CV folds for sparse metabolomics)
  bad_vars <- character(0)
  if (length(rhs_vars) > 0) {
    # Calculate SD only for the predictors present in data
    # (Use tryCatch in case a column is non-numeric weirdly)
    sds <- vapply(data[, rhs_vars, drop=FALSE], function(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE), numeric(1))
    bad_vars <- names(sds)[sds == 0 | is.na(sds)]
  }
  
  # 3. If bad variables exist, remove them from the formula dynamically
  use_form <- formula_fix
  if (length(bad_vars) > 0) {
    keep_vars <- setdiff(rhs_vars, bad_vars)
    if (length(keep_vars) == 0) return(NULL) # Crash if no predictors left
    
    # Reconstruct formula without bad vars
    use_form <- as.formula(paste("infected ~", paste(keep_vars, collapse = " + ")))
  }
  
  # 4. Fit the model
  out <- try(
    glmmLasso(
      fix = use_form, rnd = rnd, family = family, data = data,
      lambda = lambda,
      
      # --- CORRECT PLACEMENT HERE ---
      control = list(maxIter = 1000)
      # ------------------------------
    ),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (inherits(out, "try-error")) NULL else out
}

auc_from_fit <- function(fit, newdata, y_vec) {
  p <- predict(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "response") %>% as.numeric()
  pROC::auc(pROC::roc(response = y_vec, predictor = p, levels = c(0,1), direction = "<")) %>% as.numeric()
}

subject_split_stratified <- function(df, prop = 0.8, max_tries = 50) {
  subs <- df$Subject_ID %>% as.character() %>% unique()
  n_tr <- floor(length(subs) * prop)
  for (i in seq_len(max_tries)) {
    tr_sub <- sample(subs, size = n_tr, replace = FALSE)
    train  <- df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_sub)
    test   <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!Subject_ID %in% tr_sub)
    if (length(unique(test$infected)) == 2) return(list(train = train, test = test))
  }
  warning("Could not guarantee class balance in test after max_tries; proceeding with last draw.")
  list(train = train, test = test)
}

predict_at_lambda <- function(train_df, test_df, formula_fix, lambda) {
  fit <- safe_fit_once(formula_fix, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), train_df, lambda)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  prob <- predict(fit, newdata = test_df, type = "response") %>% as.numeric()
  tibble::tibble(sample = test_df$sample, Subject_ID = test_df$Subject_ID,
                 infected = as.numeric(test_df$infected), prob = prob)
}

# NEW: inner-CV lambda chooser used in several places
cv_lambda_auc <- function(train_df, formula_fix, lambda_seq, K = 5) {
  ids <- train_df %>% dplyr::distinct(Subject_ID, infected)

    ids <- ids %>% dplyr::mutate(fold = sample(rep(seq_len(K), length.out = n())))
  means <- vapply(lambda_seq, function(lam) {
    aucs <- numeric(K)
    for (k in seq_len(K)) {
      tr_ids <- ids$Subject_ID[ids$fold != k]
      va_ids <- ids$Subject_ID[ids$fold == k]
      tr <- train_df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_ids)
      va <- train_df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% va_ids)
      fit <- safe_fit_once(formula_fix, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), tr, lam)
      aucs[k] <- if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else auc_from_fit(fit, va, va$infected)
    }
    mean(aucs, na.rm = TRUE)
  }, numeric(1))
  lam_star <- min(lambda_seq[which(means == max(means, na.rm = TRUE))])
  list(lambda = lam_star, cv_auc = max(means, na.rm = TRUE))
}

## ------------------------------
## Train-only stability helper
## ------------------------------
train_only_stability_both <- function(train_df, form_both, lambda_seq, B = 50, Kfold = 5, seed = 1L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  sel_rows <- vector("list", B)
  
  # Get unique subjects for stratified resampling
  # (Assuming binary outcome 'infected' is constant per subject, 
  #  but simple subject resampling is usually sufficient/safer)
  u_subs <- unique(train_df$Subject_ID)
  n_subs <- length(u_subs)
  
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    # 1. RESAMPLE: Create a bootstrap sample of SUBJECTS (replacement = TRUE)
    #    or Subsample (replacement = FALSE, typically 0.8 fraction)
    #    Let's use Subsampling (0.8) as it is often more stable for Lasso selection.
    
    sub_sample_ids <- sample(u_subs, size = floor(0.8 * n_subs), replace = FALSE)
    
    # Filter data to this subsample
    curr_df <- train_df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% sub_sample_ids)
    
    # 2. INNER CV: Run CV on this SPECIFIC subsample to find its best Lambda
    #    (This preserves the rigor you asked for)
    cvb  <- cv_lambda_auc(curr_df, form_both, lambda_seq, K = Kfold)
    lamb <- cvb$lambda
    
    if (is.na(lamb)) next 
    
    # 3. FIT: Fit model on this subsample using the chosen Lambda
    fit  <- safe_fit_once(form_both, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), curr_df, lamb)
    
    if (is.null(fit)) next
    
    coef_vec <- tryCatch({
      if (is.list(fit$coefficients)) fit$coefficients$beta else fit$coefficients
    }, error = function(e) setNames(numeric(0), character(0)))
    
    nz <- which(coef_vec != 0)
    if (length(nz) == 0) next
    
    sel_rows[[b]] <- tibble::tibble(
      feature = names(coef_vec)[nz],
      coef    = as.numeric(coef_vec[nz]),
      sign    = sign(as.numeric(coef_vec[nz]))
    )
  }
  
  S <- dplyr::bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), sel_rows))
  
  if (nrow(S) == 0) {
    return(tibble::tibble(feature=character(0), n_sel=integer(0), freq=numeric(0), 
                          median_coef=numeric(0), pos_frac=numeric(0), 
                          neg_frac=numeric(0), sign_stab=numeric(0)))
  }
  
  S %>% dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_sel        = dplyr::n(),
      freq         = n_sel / B,
      median_coef  = stats::median(coef, na.rm = TRUE),
      pos_frac     = mean(sign > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      neg_frac     = mean(sign < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      sign_stab    = pmax(pos_frac, neg_frac),
      .groups      = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(freq), dplyr::desc(abs(median_coef)))
}


## ------------------------------
## Build designs and formulas
## ------------------------------
combined_met  <- clean_design(metabolic_data, outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)
combined_prot <- clean_design(
  purrr::reduce(list(physiologic_data, immune_data),
                dplyr::inner_join, by = "sample"),
  outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff
)
combined_both <- clean_design(
  purrr::reduce(list(physiologic_data, immune_data, metabolic_data),
                dplyr::inner_join, by = "sample"),
  outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff
)

panel_metabolites <- function(panel_name) {
  published_metabolite_features |>
    dplyr::filter(published_panel == panel_name) |>
    dplyr::pull(BIOCHEMICAL_NAME)
}

combined_fitzgerald <- metabolic_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    dplyr::any_of(panel_metabolites("Fitzgerald"))
  ) |>
  clean_design(outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)

combined_molins <- metabolic_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    dplyr::any_of(panel_metabolites("Molins"))
  ) |>
  clean_design(outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)

combined_kehoe <- metabolic_data |>
  dplyr::select(
    sample,
    dplyr::any_of(panel_metabolites("Kehoe"))
  ) |>
  clean_design(outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)

published_immune_features <- published_protein_features |>
  dplyr::filter(assay == "immune") |>
  dplyr::pull(measured_feature)
published_physiologic_features <- published_protein_features |>
  dplyr::filter(assay == "physiologic") |>
  dplyr::pull(measured_feature)

prot_ext_df <- dplyr::inner_join(
  immune_data |>
    dplyr::select(sample, dplyr::any_of(published_immune_features)),
  physiologic_data |>
    dplyr::select(sample, dplyr::any_of(published_physiologic_features)),
  by = "sample"
)
combined_prot_external <- clean_design(prot_ext_df, outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)

community_design <- clean_design(community, outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)
smallest_design <- clean_design(smallest, outcomes, corr_cut = corr_cutoff)

## Formulas
form_met            <- make_formula(combined_met)
form_prot           <- make_formula(combined_prot)
form_both           <- make_formula(combined_both)
form_prot_external  <- make_formula(combined_prot_external)
form_community      <- make_formula(community_design)
form_smallest       <- make_formula(smallest_design)
form_fitzgerald     <- make_formula(combined_fitzgerald)
form_molins         <- make_formula(combined_molins)
form_kehoe          <- make_formula(combined_kehoe)

# --- GRID DEFINITIONS ---

# 1. Tiny Grid (For Fitzgerald, Kehoe, Molins - ~20-50 vars)
#    These need small penalties, or they flatline.
lam_seq_tiny <- lambda_grid_log(0.1, 10, 10)

# 2. Small Grid (For Prot, Smallest, Community - ~90 vars)
#    Your original range was actually pretty good for these.
lam_seq_small <- lambda_grid_log(1, 30, 10)

# 3. Large Grid (For Met, Both - ~900+ vars)
#    These need higher penalties, but now that we fixed the "Rank" crash,
#    we don't need to go insanely high.
lam_seq_large <- lambda_grid_log(0.1, 50, 15)

## competitor universes (K per dataset), sanitized once
nonpred <- c("sample","Subject_ID","Condition","time","infected")
pred_cols_fitzgerald    <- setdiff(names(combined_fitzgerald),   nonpred)
pred_cols_kehoe         <- setdiff(names(combined_kehoe),        nonpred)
pred_cols_molins        <- setdiff(names(combined_molins),       nonpred)
pred_cols_prot_external <- setdiff(names(combined_prot_external),nonpred)

comp_sets <- tibble::tibble(
  competitor = c("fitzgerald","kehoe","molins","prot_external"),
  universe   = list(pred_cols_fitzgerald, pred_cols_kehoe, pred_cols_molins, pred_cols_prot_external)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    universe = purrr::map(universe, ~ make.names(as.character(.x))),
    K        = purrr::map_int(universe, length)
  )
K_by_comp <- setNames(comp_sets$K, comp_sets$competitor)

## ------------------------------
## Simulations (outer) with inner-CV λ + per-split fair-K
## ------------------------------
B_stab <- 50

# ---- progressr safety guard
use_progress <- requireNamespace("progressr", quietly = TRUE)

if (use_progress) {
  # force a basic built-in handler; ignore any stale per-session options
  progressr::handlers(global = TRUE)
  progressr::handlers("txtprogressbar")     # or "cli" if you prefer and have {cli} installed
} else {
  options(progressr.enable = FALSE)
}

if (!inherits(future::plan(), "multisession")) {
  future::plan(future::multisession, workers = workers)
}

progressr::with_progress({
  p <- progressr::progressor(steps = n_sim)

  models <- list(
    both          = list(df = combined_both,       form = form_both),
    met           = list(df = combined_met,        form = form_met),
    prot          = list(df = combined_prot,       form = form_prot),
    community     = list(df = community_design,    form = form_community),
    smallest      = list(df = smallest_design,     form = form_smallest),
    fitzgerald    = list(df = combined_fitzgerald, form = form_fitzgerald),
    kehoe         = list(df = combined_kehoe,      form = form_kehoe),
    molins        = list(df = combined_molins,     form = form_molins),
    prot_external = list(df = combined_prot_external, form = form_prot_external)
  )


  sim_out <<- furrr::future_map(
    seq_len(n_sim),
    function(sim) {
      p()
      # Outer split defined on 'both'
      sp_both <- subject_split_stratified(models$both$df, prop = 0.8, max_tries = max_resample)
      tr_ids  <- as.character(sp_both$train$Subject_ID)
      te_ids  <- as.character(sp_both$test$Subject_ID)

      out_rows  <- vector("list", length(models))
      sel_rows  <- vector("list", length(models))
      pred_rows <- vector("list", length(models))
      i <- 0

      # A) reference models
      for (nm in names(models)) {
        i <- i + 1
        
# --- NEW LOGIC START ---
        if (nm %in% c("fitzgerald", "kehoe", "molins", "prot_external")) {
          # Tiny models (< 50 vars) 
          # ADDED prot_external HERE
          current_seq <- lam_seq_tiny
          
        } else if (nm %in% c("met", "both")) {
          # Huge models (> 500 vars)
          # REMOVED prot_external FROM HERE
          current_seq <- lam_seq_large
          
        } else {
          # Standard models (prot, smallest, community)
          current_seq <- lam_seq_small
        }
        # --- NEW LOGIC END ---
        
        sp   <- list(
          train = models[[nm]]$df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_ids),
          test  = models[[nm]]$df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% te_ids)
        )
        form <- models[[nm]]$form

        cv   <- cv_lambda_auc(sp$train, form, current_seq, K = 5)
        
        lam  <- cv$lambda
        fit  <- safe_fit_once(form, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), sp$train, lam)
        aucv <- if (is.null(fit)) NA_real_ else auc_from_fit(fit, sp$test, sp$test$infected)
        out_rows[[i]] <- tibble::tibble(model = nm, sim = sim, lambda_success = lam, auc = aucv)

        if (!is.null(fit)) {
          coef_vec <- tryCatch({
            if (is.list(fit$coefficients)) fit$coefficients$beta else fit$coefficients
          }, error = function(e) setNames(numeric(0), character(0)))
          nz <- which(coef_vec != 0)
          sel_rows[[i]] <- if (length(nz) == 0) NULL else tibble::tibble(
            model = nm, sim = sim, feature = names(coef_vec)[nz],
            coef  = as.numeric(coef_vec[nz]), sign = sign(as.numeric(coef_vec[nz]))
          )
          pred_rows[[i]] <- predict_at_lambda(sp$train, sp$test, form, lam) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(model = nm, sim = sim, lambda_success = lam)
        }
      }

  # B) train-only stability (BOTH) + per-competitor fair-K
      train_df_both <- models$both$df %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_ids)
      
      # --- CHANGE: Use 'lam_seq_large' here because 'both' is high-dimensional ---
      stab_train    <- train_only_stability_both(train_df_both, form_both, lam_seq_large,
                                                 B = B_stab, Kfold = 5, seed = 10L + sim)
      # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
      ranked_global     <- stab_train %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(freq), dplyr::desc(abs(median_coef)))

      for (comp in names(K_by_comp)) {
        Kt  <- K_by_comp[[comp]]
        
        # --- CORRECTED LOGIC START ---
        # We want the frequency of the K-th feature in the ranked list.
        # If the list has fewer than Kt features, we take the minimum frequency found.
        
        if (nrow(ranked_global) == 0) {
           thr <- NA_real_
        } else if (nrow(ranked_global) >= Kt) {
           # Take the frequency of the K-th feature
           thr <- ranked_global$freq[Kt]
        } else {
           # If we don't have K features total, take the lowest frequency available
           thr <- min(ranked_global$freq, na.rm = TRUE)
        }
        # --- CORRECTED LOGIC END ---
        sel_feats <- if (is.na(thr)) character(0) else
          ranked_global %>% dplyr::filter(freq >= thr) %>% dplyr::pull(feature) %>% as.character()

        model_name <- paste0("both_fairK_", comp)
        if (length(sel_feats) == 0) {
          out_rows[[length(out_rows) + 1L]] <-
            tibble::tibble(model = model_name, sim = sim, lambda_success = NA_real_, auc = NA_real_)
          next
        }

        use_feats <- intersect(sel_feats, names(combined_both))
        if (length(use_feats) == 0) {
          out_rows[[length(out_rows) + 1L]] <-
            tibble::tibble(model = model_name, sim = sim, lambda_success = NA_real_, auc = NA_real_)
          next
        }

        base_cols <- intersect(nonpred, names(combined_both))
        df_small  <- combined_both %>% dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c(base_cols, use_feats)))
        tr_df     <- df_small %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% tr_ids)
        te_df     <- df_small %>% dplyr::filter(Subject_ID %in% te_ids)

        form_fk <- stats::as.formula(paste0("infected ~ ", paste(use_feats, collapse = " + ")))
# --- CHANGE: Use 'lam_seq_tiny' here because these models are very small ---
        cv_fk   <- cv_lambda_auc(tr_df, form_fk, lam_seq_tiny, K = 5)
        # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
        lam_fk  <- cv_fk$lambda

        fit_fk <- safe_fit_once(form_fk, list(Subject_ID = ~1), binomial(), tr_df, lam_fk)
        auc_fk <- if (is.null(fit_fk)) NA_real_ else auc_from_fit(fit_fk, te_df, te_df$infected)

        out_rows[[length(out_rows) + 1L]] <-
          tibble::tibble(model = model_name, sim = sim, lambda_success = lam_fk, auc = auc_fk)
      }

      list(
        metrics = dplyr::bind_rows(out_rows),
        sel     = dplyr::bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), sel_rows)),
        preds   = dplyr::bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), pred_rows)),
        ids     = tibble::tibble(sim = sim, train_ids = list(tr_ids), test_ids = list(te_ids))
      )
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
})

## ------------------------------
## Recombine
## ------------------------------
results     <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(sim_out, `[[`, "metrics")) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(model, sim, lambda_success, auc)
predictions <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(sim_out, `[[`, "preds")) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(model, sim, lambda_success, sample, Subject_ID, infected, prob)
selections  <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(sim_out, `[[`, "sel"))

## ------------------------------
## Stability (BOTH only, across all outer splits)
## ------------------------------
stability_both <- selections %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == "both") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_sel        = dplyr::n(),
    freq         = n_sel / n_sim,
    median_coef  = stats::median(coef, na.rm = TRUE),
    pos_frac     = mean(sign > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    neg_frac     = mean(sign < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    sign_stab    = pmax(pos_frac, neg_frac),
    pred_sign    = dplyr::if_else(pos_frac >= neg_frac, "+", "-"),
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(feature = make.names(as.character(feature))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(freq), dplyr::desc(abs(median_coef)))

## ------------------------------
## Competitor universes + diagnostics
## ------------------------------
both_all <- setdiff(names(combined_both), nonpred) %>% make.names()

name_check <- tibble::tibble(
  competitor = comp_sets$competitor,
  n_universe = purrr::map_int(comp_sets$universe, length),
  in_both_all = purrr::map_int(comp_sets$universe, ~ sum(.x %in% both_all)),
  in_stability = purrr::map_int(comp_sets$universe, ~ sum(.x %in% stability_both$feature)),
  present_not_selected = purrr::map(comp_sets$universe, ~ setdiff(intersect(.x, both_all), stability_both$feature))
)
message("\n--- COMPETITOR PRESENCE CHECK ---")

#--- COMPETITOR PRESENCE CHECK ---
print(name_check %>% dplyr::select(competitor, n_universe, in_both_all, in_stability))


diag_comp <- tibble::tibble(
  competitor = comp_sets$competitor
) %>% dplyr::mutate(
  overlap_feats = comp_sets$universe %>% purrr::map(~ intersect(.x, stability_both$feature)),
  n_universe    = purrr::map_int(comp_sets$universe, length),
  n_overlap     = purrr::map_int(overlap_feats, length),
  n_distinct_freq = purrr::map_int(
    overlap_feats, ~ length(unique(stability_both$freq[match(.x, stability_both$feature)]))
  )
)
message("\n--- OVERLAP WITH BOTH-SELECTION BY COMPETITOR ---")

#--- OVERLAP WITH BOTH-SELECTION BY COMPETITOR ---
print(diag_comp %>% dplyr::select(competitor, n_universe, n_overlap, n_distinct_freq))

## ------------------------------
## Summary table
## ------------------------------
summary_tbl <- results %>%
  dplyr::group_by(model) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    R             = sum(!is.na(auc)),
    mean_auc      = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_auc        = stats::sd(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_auc        = sd_auc / sqrt(pmax(R, 1)),
    ci95_half     = 1.96 * se_auc,
    ci95_low      = mean_auc - ci95_half,
    ci95_high     = mean_auc + ci95_half,
    median_lambda = suppressWarnings(stats::median(lambda_success, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_auc))

## ------------------------------
## Save
## ------------------------------
dir.create(dirname(auc_results_path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
readr::write_csv(results, auc_results_path)

# Use the newly generated results for the figure panels in this render.
auc_results <- results
results_with_k <- auc_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    model = as.character(model),
    sim = as.integer(sim),
    auc = as.numeric(auc)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(model_metadata, by = "model")
benchmark_results_available <- TRUE
```

```{r panel_a, eval=benchmark_results_available}
s5_text_size <- 8 / ggplot2::.pt

plot_data_paired <- results_with_k |>
  dplyr::inner_join(competitor_map, by = "model") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    universe = dplyr::recode(
      universe,
      "Prot Ext" = "External Proteins"

    universe = factor(
      universe,
      levels = unique(dplyr::recode(
        competitor_map$universe,
        "Prot Ext" = "External Proteins"
      ))
    ),
    type = factor(type, levels = c("Competitor", "Our Method")),
    type_position = as.numeric(type)
  )

panel_a_k_labels <- plot_data_paired |>
  dplyr::group_by(universe) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    label_k = paste(unique(label_k), collapse = " / "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>

    x = 1.5,
    y = 0.4

p_paired <- ggplot(plot_data_paired, aes(x = type_position, y = auc)) +

  geom_boxplot(aes(group = type_position), outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = sim, color = as.factor(sim)),
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = as.factor(sim)), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_k),
    data = panel_a_k_labels,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = s5_text_size,
    family = "Arial",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(

  scale_y_continuous(

  ylab("AUC") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial", size = 8, face = "plain"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  panel_a_file,

)
```
